static_traits.name: Wang Dawei
static_traits.social_status: Having a few close friends, but not yet discussing her shame and Self-doubt with them; friendships somewhat strained by negative self-perception.
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness history; not yet sought care or received counseling for psychological problems before.
static_traits.language_features: Clear logic, able to describe experiences concretely; slightly Anxious at first help-seeking but highly cooperative; marked self-criticism, often using 'should' sentences and negative labels.

basic_info.main_problem: I see myself as a useless person because I cannot cook, which leads to Self-doubt and inadequacy.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizing that these thoughts are affecting my self-esteem and overall well-being, therefore seeking psychological counseling.
growth_experiences: After moving out to live alone, long relying on takeout for not being able to cook; initial stress moderate, then shame and Self-doubt gradually worsened from repeated cooking failures and seeing others cook effortlessly, each cooking attempt ending in 'failure'.
Long commutes and traffic stress affecting Work performance and energy load; friendships strained by negative self-perception, but not yet expressing to friends or seeking support.

special_situations.event: Each attempt at cooking usually ends in failure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot even do basic cooking, it shows I am useless.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Watches online tutorials and strictly follows recipes to prove she can do it.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot do it well, showing I am just useless.

special_situations.event: Seeing others easily prepare and finish a meal
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do it easily while I cannot, it shows I am worse than them, I am terrible.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles down on learning: watches online tutorials and tries following recipes.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am worse than them, I am so embarrassing.

special_situations.event: Needing to cook for herself after Living alone yet having to rely on takeout
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Independent living should mean being able to cook for oneself; failing means being an unqualified adult.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Relies more on takeout to avoid failing and feeling ashamed again.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not suited for independent living.

special_situations.event: Commute and traffic stress causing Work performance affected
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If Work performance is affected, it shows my overall ability is poor, I as a person am no good.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focusing on her own inadequacy labels to try self-restraint.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot even do Work well, I am just useless.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as a capable person worthy of respect, able to manage independent living (including self-care abilities such as cooking).
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as 'useless' by herself or others, experiencing strong shame and Being rejected or looked down on.
defense_goal: Through self-labeling negatively and self-criticism preemptively, reduces the risk of being judged by others
Maintaining fragile self-esteem and safety by not seeking help and not exposing weaknesses

object_relations.self_representation: A shamed, incapable Living alone person
object_relations.object_representation: Others (those who can cook) are people who are effortlessly competent and may judge me
Friends are supporters, but may look down on me for not being able to cook
object_relations.linking_affect: Embarrassment, worry, longing to be understood

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others suggest talking with friends about feelings and seeking support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client worries friends will think she cannot even do basic skills, thus looking down on her (Projecting self-judgment onto others).
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Hesitant tone, using vague expressions (e.g. 'they might think......'), avoiding committing to communicate with friends immediately, mildly avoiding details.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to review cooking failures or set specific practice goals
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equating one failure with overall incapability, consolidating the negative self-image through Self-deprecation.
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding with Self-denial statements (e.g. 'this shows I am just useless'), low tone, ignoring or devaluing positive evidence.

manifestations: After moving out to live alone, needing to face daily self-care (cooking) alone yet repeatedly failing
Not yet expressing true feelings and shame to friends
outcomes: Tense relationships with friends, avoiding help-seeking

manifestations: Responsibilities of independent living (cooking and self-care) are seen as basic abilities that must be mastered
Experiencing pressure and Anxiety when taking on life responsibilities
outcomes: Declining self-evaluation, defining oneself with negative labels

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 'Cooking is a basic skill, I should already know it'
Defining self-worth by external standards (whether one can cook)

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: Knowing friends are supportive yet not expressing or seeking help
Pushes back the impulse to seek support, choosing to bear shame and inferiority alone

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequent self-criticism and using the 'useless person' label
When discussing seeking help, excessively worries about being looked down on, expresses cautiously

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Assuming others will look down on her for not being able to cook
Worries friends will judge oneself for this and avoids sharing

positive_force: Has some ability and success experience in the work field
Has a supportive network of close friends
Willing to learn (watch online tutorials), maintains a positive attitude toward counseling
Willing to try self-compassion and cognitive restructuring exercises
negative_force: Labeling herself in an all-or-nothing way ('cannot cook = useless person')
'Should' rules and external comparison reinforcing shame
Shame and embarrassment hinder help-seeking and practice
Commute and traffic Increased stress overall load, lowering energy and patience

target_behavior.behavior: When trying to cook, strong self-deprecation appears and practice is quickly abandoned, turning to relying on takeout instead
antecedent: Needing to cook or prepare a meal while Living alone
target_behavior.core_reason: Directly equating not being able to cook with self-worth, forming catastrophic and all-or-nothing self-evaluation ('cannot cook = useless person').
target_behavior.function: Avoiding failure and shame, relieving Anxiety in the short term and maintaining surface self-esteem safety.
target_behavior.consequence: Long-term reliance on unhealthy diet and takeout, reinforcing Self-doubt and shame, further affecting Interpersonal relationships and Work status.
